bench_aligners_curated.title: Curated correctness probes
bench_aligners_curated.description: Curated correctness probes (replaces the legacy `[simple-benchmark]` Catch2 test cases). Asserts both unique-fragment primary correctness and SEAL-style batch behaviour. On purpose evaluates one sample for very long sequence (XXL_HIFI)

test_case_descriptions.SHORT_HIFI: 300 bp fragments, ~0.2% HiFi-style error, 3 kbp reference
test_case_descriptions.MEDIUM_HIFI: 5 kbp fragments, ~0.2% HiFi-style error, 30 kbp reference
test_case_descriptions.LONG_HIFI: 50 kbp fragments, ~0.2% HiFi error, 250 kbp reference
test_case_descriptions.XXL_HIFI: 0.5 Gbp reference to 5 Mbp fragment, ~0.2% HiFi error
test_case_descriptions.RMQ_REPRO_LONG_CCS: Pinned (LONG, CCS) seed that previously segfaulted on bioseq-RMQ chaining
test_case_descriptions.CURATED_UNIQUE_FRAGMENT: Single error-free fragment from a 2 kbp random reference — trivial alignment
test_case_descriptions.CURATED_SEAL_BATCH: SEAL-style 8-fragment batch with mild error and reverse-complement

bench_aligners_rmq_repro.title: RMQ chaining LONG/CCS regression repro
bench_aligners_rmq_repro.description: Pinned (LONG, CCS) seed that previously segfaulted on bioseq-RMQ chaining (AVL rebalance bug, fixed in chaining_rmq.cppm). One row, asserts non-zero match count.
